Cartier Love: $7,950 at Cartier, about $3,200 of gold inside, says New York jeweller Ezra Feldstein after 40 years on 47th Street.
The turn: on the resale market a classic Love trades at two-thirds to four-fifths of retail, so you keep about 70 percent. With most luxury names you lose most of it the day you buy.
Figures as spoken: Cartier's US list price as he recorded it on 14 October 2026, about 24 g of pure gold at that day's price.
Video: Ezra Feldstein, YouTube, 14 October 2026.
